fields.label: Uffizio Alert ID
fields.description: getAlertData alert_id — identifies the alert TYPE. Several rows may share an id when match text splits it.

fields.label: Match Text
fields.description: Optional. Only applies when the alert's text contains this (case-insensitive); the longest matching text wins, a row without text is the fallback. E.g. id 169 carries both 'Device Status Lock' and 'Device Status Unlock'.

fields.label: Category
fields.options:
Security
Connectivity
Battery
Geofence
Route
Operational
Other
fields.description: Shared with the locally-derived alerts. Alerts of the same seal and category merge into one open incident.

fields.label: Ignore
fields.description: Do not store alerts of this type.

fields.label: Only While On Journey
fields.description: Store only while the seal's journey is Ready for Journey or In Transit (e.g. an unlock is only an alert then).

fields.label: Record As Journey Milestone
fields.description: Add to the seal's current Seal Journey as a milestone (arrived / departed / entered / exited a place) instead of opening an alert.
